summary: Frontend-only test of Settings > Owner tool Comp Pro Access signup stats + grouped paginated users list as admin@aiadvocate.co.uk (desktop 1920x1080). All requested flows pass: signup-stats line matches GET /api/admin/signups/stats exactly (1 genuine, 0 today/24h/7d/30d, 56 test, 3 internal); comp-recent-toggle expands and shows tabs; header 'Genuine users · 1' -> 'Internal accounts · 3' (3 rows) -> 'Test accounts · 56' (25 rows, 'Load more (25 of 56)'); Load more -> 50 unique -> 56 unique, button disappears; no duplicates. Rows show date/email/name/tier/status with Grant(55)/Revoke(1)/Delete(56) rendered (none clicked). Search 'admin' -> '1 match', tabs + load-more hidden; clearing returns to Test group page 1 (25 rows, tabs back). No console errors from this feature (one pre-existing hydration warning from Reviews.js <option> injected span).

minor.issue: Only 'genuine' user in preview is test1782245767@example-fake.com (name 'Test User', status trial) - classifier misses 'example-fake.com' domain / 'test<digits>@' local part; stats also reports needs_review:1 (not surfaced in UI).

issues: Rows show redundant 'free · free' when tier and subscription_status are both 'free' - consider hiding status when equal to tier
28 of 56 test rows have no created_at so no date shown (expected per spec, but older users lack a date)
Stats line wraps '3 internal' onto a 2nd line at modal width - cosmetic

action_items: Optional: tighten genuine classifier (example-fake.com, test<digits>@ patterns) or surface needs_review count in SignupStatsLine
Optional: guard loadRecent against stale responses (tab switch while a request/Load more is in flight can mix groups or append twice); disable Load more while loading
Optional: hide subscription_status when it duplicates tier
critical_code_review_comments: loadRecent has no in-flight/stale-request guard: rapid tab switching or double-clicking Load more can append the wrong group's page or the same page twice (setResults uses prev append).
loadRecent swallows errors silently (no error state/feedback).
Pre-existing console warning: Reviews.js line 79 <option> contains injected <span> (visual-edit tooling) - hydration warning, unrelated to this feature.
seed_data_creation: None. No Grant/Revoke/Delete clicked; no data modified.
